exposure: proportional change of anteroposterior diameter (APD) of levator hiatus from rest to maximum Valsalva maneuver
outcome: duration of active second stage of labor
cohort: 486 nulliparous women at term before the onset of labor
finding: Women with a higher increase in the anteroposterior diameter of the levator hiatus from rest to Valsalva have a shorter active second stage of labor.
mod_finding: While a higher increase in anteroposterior diameter of the levator hiatus from rest to Valsalva was associated with shorter active second stage labor duration, no association was found between this change and mode of delivery.
